text: Assessment 2026-07-08: baseline verified green (145 tests, JVM+JS, graphics/graphics-svg/design). Current grade ~7.5-8/10. Strengths: typed invariants (ExtentExpr non-negativity, open/closed transform domains, error ADT), renderer-neutral IR with row-level drop diagnostics, scene monoid, dual-platform tests. Gaps driving the revision: 8-fold aesthetic hand-enumeration; monolithic compiler; scales trained by callers and duplicated into PanelLayout; guides ignore scale breaks; hard-coded npc frames/legend origins in DesignGraphics; y-axis mirroring blessed by SvgRendererSuite; calc()/percent length emission; Geom.Line ignores group/per-row gp.
